captureRequirements.language: Change the actual DSH UI language before each language capture; restore the observed original setting afterward.
captureRequirements.privacy: Exclude private project names, local paths and real conversation contents. Use a deliberately created demonstration conversation for handoff; do not fabricate a successful result.
captureRequirements.acceptance: Open every captured image. Verify readable controls, matching UI language, no privacy leaks, no loading/error state, and evidence for each caption.
captureRequirements.missingAssets: All asset fields remain null until an actual screenshot exists. Do not render or add README media links with missing assets.
